title: Super-major-index multiplicities in free Lie superalgebra components
author: Armon, Sam; Swanson, Joshua P.
work: Super major index and Thrall’s problem

primary_locator.required_new_core: complete super tableau/descent/major-comajor specializations and bijection, super-Schur hook formula and root-of-unity character extraction

difficulty_reason: The proof develops super tableau major-index specialization, converts super Schur expansions into root-of-unity filtered characters, and extracts the prescribed odd degree. Sections 5–6 carry the descent/comajor bijection and cyclic character calculation needed for the multiplicity formula, beyond a standard Schur–Weyl decomposition.
